candidate.label: candidate
candidate.method: Bounded sliding control-window candidate over admission-reuse 230cd4f; ephemeral capture remains reverted. The existing capture-confirm-control cohort is a historical reference, not a fresh adjacent randomized pair. Control exchange metrics change from batches to frames; queue metrics remain per frame. Fresh persistent host node volumes through Colima virtiofs and external RustFS on the 288-GiB VM disk. Cold benchmark VM restart per cohort. Three nodes, 1 vCPU and 3 GiB each, 500 leaders and 1000 followers each, 1500 groups/3 voters, four SQL workers with 16 slots each (64 total), four archive retained-cut slots. Two 180-second windows at 24 writers. Same load AST. Quorum acknowledgements, exact 4500 replica values and 1500 archive positions; timed mutations never retry. Shared-host activity recorded; existing cumulative metrics are sampled outside each timed load process; this task performs no builds or profiling during timing. Compare sustained throughput and p99 without converting reconciliation into a timed pass.

method_limits: The control cohort predates this candidate and other experiments intervene. This is a historical reference, not a fresh adjacent randomized pair.
All cohorts run on a shared host with observed activity. Relative throughput alone is not causal attribution.
Successful-request percentiles exclude error responses. Every window must have zero errors and p99 below 500 ms.
Candidate control exchange timers count frames; historical control timers count batches. Do not compare their means or counts as equivalent work.
Queue timers remain per frame; completed observations overlap and are not distinct client requests.
Final archive coverage is separately verified; boundary lag is not a continuous steady-state bound.
No positional join of sorted success samples with receipts is valid. No such phase analysis is used.
Timed mutations never retry. Reconciliation cannot convert a failed timed window into a pass.
